conf.description: siem-software-factory POC: turn saved sample records back into their original events for Splunk index=devlogs over HEC. Used only by collector poc-dataset-replay.

conf.comment: Input: one events.jsonl record per event (breaker poc-dataset-jsonl). Output: the original _raw, _time, host, source and sourcetype; index forced to devlogs; sf_* correlation fields sent as HEC indexed fields.

functions.description: Restore original event from the sample record
Send only the original event and the correlation fields
